messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: repulsive log-potential with collinearity penalty terms

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square under a repulsive log-potential with collinearity penalty terms places the points at the vertices and edge-midpoints of a regular hexagon inscribed in the square, plus its center and two points at the golden-ratio-split of the square's diagonals, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/72; the collinearity penalty must be of the form λ·Σ(1/εᵢ²) where εᵢ is the perpendicular distance of each point to each line through any two others, and as λ→∞ this potential's unique minimizer converges to the area-optimal configuration."}
